text: Self-hosted AI platform designed to run entirely offline
quote: self-hosted AI platform that's extensible, feature-rich, user-friendly, and built to run entirely offline

text: Supports fully air-gapped deployment with complete network isolation
quote: Air-Gapped: Complete network isolation for environments with the strictest security requirements.

text: Provider-agnostic interface for local and cloud models via Ollama and OpenAI-compatible APIs
quote: With support for Ollama and OpenAI-compatible APIs, it gives you a powerful, provider-agnostic interface for both local and cloud-based models.

text: Any OpenAI-compatible provider (Ollama, OpenRouter, vLLM, LM Studio, Groq) can be added using a custom base URL
quote: anything that speaks the OpenAI API (Ollama, OpenRouter, vLLM, LM Studio, Groq, ...) is added as provider OpenAI with a custom Base URL.

text: Connects to Ollama, OpenAI-compatible, and Open Responses providers out of the box
quote: Open WebUI runs anywhere (Docker, Kubernetes, pip, bare metal) and connects to Ollama, OpenAI-compatible, and Open Responses providers out of the box.

text: Switch models mid-conversation while keeping context intact
quote: Talk to any model, switch mid-conversation, and keep your context intact.

text: Run two models side by side and compare their responses
quote: Run two models side-by-side and compare responses

text: Choose which service handles each job, such as speech or search
quote: Open WebUI lets you choose which service does each job.

text: Personal API keys let external code call the same endpoints the web UI uses
quote: An API key is a personal access token that lets external code call the same endpoints the web UI uses.

text: Python Function plugins can add new models and intercept or transform every message
quote: They can add entirely new "models" powered by any Python logic, intercept and transform every message flowing through the system

text: Custom models or agents built as plugins appear as selectable models in the chat sidebar
quote: Adds a custom model or agent | Appears as a selectable model in the chat sidebar

text: Connect external tool servers to give the agent tools beyond the built-ins
quote: Give the agent tools beyond the built-ins by connecting external tool servers in Settings → Admin → Tool Servers.

text: Native MCP support for calling tools exposed by MCP servers
quote: Open WebUI natively supports MCP (Model Context Protocol) starting in v0.6.31.

text: Skills are SKILL.md folders of reusable instructions the AI can load on demand
quote: A skill is a folder with a SKILL.md file: a reusable instruction set the AI can pull in on demand

text: The AI can save a procedure you describe as a new reusable skill
quote: Save this whole procedure as a skill called release-checklist. Include the tag format and the announcement template.

text: Automatically picks up existing skills and CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md files from other tools
quote: if you already keep skills or a CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md for another tool, Computer picks them up automatically.

text: Automations run prompts on recurring schedules, with each run executing as a chat
quote: Automations let you schedule prompts to run automatically at recurring times. Each run creates a chat and executes through the normal chat completion pipeline

text: Scheduled tasks can run a test suite on a recurring basis and report failures with error output
quote: Schedule a task that runs the test suite every weekday at 9 and reports failures with the error output.

text: AI web search with real-time source citations
quote: AI searches the web and cites sources in real time

text: Web search works without configuration, using DuckDuckGo by default
quote: Web search works out of the box: with no configuration at all, the AI searches via DuckDuckGo.

text: Agentic mode lets models autonomously explore the web, verify facts, and follow links
quote: By enabling Native Function Calling (Agentic Mode), you allow quality models to independently explore the web, verify facts, and follow links autonomously.

text: Memory system remembers facts, preferences, and context across conversations
quote: Open WebUI includes a sophisticated memory system that allows models to remember facts, preferences, and context across different conversations.

text: Users can manually add, edit, or delete stored memories in settings
quote: Users can manually add, edit, or delete memories by navigating to: Settings > Personalization > Memory

text: RAG retrieves from local and remote documents, web content, and YouTube videos to ground answers
quote: retrieving relevant information from a wide range of sources such as local and remote documents, web content, and even multimedia sources like YouTube videos.

text: @-mention a file to feed its content to the AI as context
quote: @ mentions a file; its content is fed to the AI as context.

text: Channels are shared, persistent spaces where multiple users and models converse in one timeline
quote: Channels let multiple users and multiple models interact in a single timeline.

text: AI can delegate work to parallel sub-agents, each a full chat with tool access
quote: The AI can delegate work to parallel sub-agents with the delegate_task tool. Each sub-agent is a full chat with tool access

text: Built-in file browser with syntax-highlighted editing and previews of Markdown, PDF, CSV, and Office files
quote: Files: browse, edit with syntax highlighting, preview Markdown, PDFs, CSVs, and Office files.

text: Shows the full agent history of file reads, edits, and pending approvals as tool cards with Allow/Deny buttons
quote: You see the full history: every file it read, every edit it made, and the pending approval that's blocking it, rendered as tool cards with Allow / Deny buttons.

text: Per-chat tool approval mode; in auto mode the AI can explore, but disk changes and commands need your approval
quote: auto is the everyday setting: the AI can explore freely, but nothing changes on disk and no command runs until you say so.

text: Review agent proposals, answer its questions, and let it continue remotely without being at your desk
quote: You want to see what it's proposing, answer its question, and let it continue, without being at the desk

text: Run Python directly in the browser or through Open Terminal
quote: Run Python directly in the browser or via Open Terminal

text: Use existing Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, Grok, OpenCode, Cline, or Pi CLI logins as chat backends without API keys
quote: Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, Grok, OpenCode, Cline, or Pi run as native chat backends using the CLI login already on your machine. No API key needed.

text: Runs one worktree, workspace, and agent per task, all supervised from a single browser tab
quote: one worktree per task, one workspace per worktree, one agent per workspace, all supervised from a single browser tab.

text: Gateway exposes each workspace as an OpenAI-compatible model, so any OpenAI-style client can run agent tasks
quote: The gateway exposes each of your workspaces as an OpenAI-compatible model, so any OpenAI-style client can run agent tasks in a real workspace.

text: Provides a CLI with a single command, cptr run
quote: The CLI has exactly one command: cptr run

text: Speech-to-text, text-to-speech, and hands-free voice and video calls
quote: Speech-to-text, text-to-speech, hands-free voice & video calls

text: Streams text-to-speech sentence by sentence, so playback starts before the response finishes
quote: Responses are read aloud sentence by sentence as they stream, so playback starts before the response finishes.

text: Image generation via OpenAI APIs, with a choice of DALL·E 2, DALL·E 3, and GPT-Image models
quote: This option includes a selector for choosing between DALL·E 2, DALL·E 3, and the GPT-Image models, each supporting different image sizes.

text: Installable as a Progressive Web App on phone home screens, desktop taskbars, and docks
quote: Open WebUI is a Progressive Web App (PWA). Add it to your phone's home screen, your desktop taskbar, or your dock.

text: Role-based access control lets admins manage user capabilities and resource access
quote: Open WebUI implements a flexible and secure Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) system.

text: Personal webhook notifies users when a chat response is ready
quote: A personal webhook that notifies individual users when a response to their chat is ready, especially useful for long-running tasks.

text: Webhooks send notifications to Discord or Slack and accept posts from external services into channels
quote: receive automated notifications in external services like Discord, Slack ... as well as post messages from external services into Open WebUI channels.

text: Install via pip, uv, Docker, or Kubernetes (kubectl, kustomize, helm)
quote: Effortless Setup: Install seamlessly via pip, uv, Docker, or Kubernetes (kubectl, kustomize, or helm)

text: A single documented command pulls the image and starts the app
quote: run the command below; it pulls the image and starts it

text: Reach your real files in a browser in about two minutes with Python 3.10+, no AI key, account, or cloud needed
quote: From zero to your real files in a browser, in about two minutes. You need Python 3.10+ ... No AI key, no account with anyone, no cloud.

text: Share what you build and run extensions others share
quote: Connect to any model, local or cloud. Extend with Python. Share what you build, run what others share.
